message:
feat!: fail closed when a response content type is not declared in the content map

When a route declares a per-media-type (`content`) response schema but the
response `Content-Type` is neither a declared key nor `*/*`, the payload was
previously serialized with a raw `JSON.stringify`. That fallback bypassed the
response schema and could expose fields the schema was meant to strip.

The route response path now fails closed. If the response content type is not
declared and no `*/*` catch-all matches, `getSchemaSerializer` throws
`FST_ERR_MISSING_CONTENTTYPE_SERIALIZATION_FN` and the reply is a `500`,
surfacing the misconfiguration instead of silently returning unsanitized data.

The error handler call path is unchanged: it still resolves the default error
serializer (requesting `failClosed: false`), so error responses are unaffected.
